use_steer_prediction.description: flag for using steer prediction (do not use steer measurement)

use_delayed_initial_state.description: flag to use x0_delayed as initial state for predicted trajectory

use_trajectory_steering_for_feedforward.description: in temporal mode, use trajectory steering for feed-forward when at least one input steering value is nonzero; otherwise use geometric curvature

steering_direct_passthrough.description: when true, publish trajectory front_wheel_angle_rad directly and skip MPC QP (MPPI passthrough)

steering_passthrough_timeout.description: maximum trajectory stamp age for executing the first MPPI command [s]; expired input holds the last published steering

steering_passthrough_rate_limit_rad_s.description: absolute bound on published steering command-rate feedforward [rad/s]; does not slew-limit the requested angle
